COUNTERTURN — SOURCE AND THIRD-PARTY NOTICES
==========================================

ORIGINAL WORK

The model arrangement, finite program, placement generator, original checks,
lessons, assembly/mechanics guides and visualization layout are credited to
CrispStrobe. Copyright (c) 2026 CrispStrobe / Christian Ströbele.
BSD-3-Clause; see licenses/counterturn.txt.

The central right-angle drive is adapted from the pinned application's
BSD-3-Clause test/fixtures/bw-sim/gears/bevel-12-20.json fixture, as credited in
the generator. The free carrier, balanced flywheel, support, mounts, retention,
physical locking control and experiment are developed for this add-on. No
external photographs or model-building instructions are redistributed.
The explanation cites the reaction-wheel principle described by NASA in
Basics of Space Flight, Chapter 11:
https://science.nasa.gov/learn/basics-of-space-flight/chapter11-2/
That source document is not redistributed.

APPLICATION AND ADAPTED HELPERS

https://github.com/CrispStrobe/brickwright-lite
Revision: 0a23bd8446f3cdb9a51668ea17dedb054648480a
BSD-3-Clause; see licenses/brickwright-source.txt.

Drive fixture:
https://github.com/CrispStrobe/brickwright-lite/blob/0a23bd8446f3cdb9a51668ea17dedb054648480a/test/fixtures/bw-sim/gears/bevel-12-20.json

The marked helper section in source/check_model_mesh.mjs is copied unchanged
from the selected app's test/bw-sim-models-solid.test.mjs, retaining attribution.
The other original wrappers and rendering helpers use methods developed for
the preceding CrispStrobe add-ons. Their source and dependency identities are
recorded in the accompanying evidence.

The native verifier imports the actual registering compiler, overlaid VM,
Robot Lab extension, hub/controller, Jolt session and official test clock.
No upstream source, device metadata, controller or physics change was made
for Counterturn. All runtime/part-library installations remain external.

EXTERNAL LDRAW GEOMETRY

The main model uses 23 standard rigid part types. Its physical locking control
adds one further type. Together they resolve to 273 external dependency files.
The LDR/MPD reference that standard geometry without bundling the mesh library.
The CAD illustration renders its surfaces in this original arrangement.

Source archive: https://library.ldraw.org/library/updates/complete.zip
Recorded date: 2026-09-30
SHA256: f3e496d0ede69ca7942fa4aa198e661ee2d22723906101e2e339d8917a4dd5f2

All selected geometry offers the CC BY 4.0 license option. This package uses
that option. Original texts are retained in licenses/CAreadme.txt,
licenses/CAlicense4.txt and licenses/CAlicense.txt.
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Per-file authors, license headers, history notices, sizes and exact hashes are
retained in evidence/dependencies.json. That complete attribution record is
part of this notice and covers nested primitives and subparts as well as the
named top-level parts. The standard part files themselves are unchanged.

RUNTIME AND PRESENTATION DEPENDENCIES

source/runtime/package-lock.json pins the separately installed Node runtime
dependencies. Their license texts remain in their separately obtained packages;
no node_modules or complete runtime tree is redistributed. Jolt 1.1.0-bw.5,
Scratch VM 4.8.115 with the app's own overlay, and the tested Python/NumPy,
Matplotlib and Pillow versions are recorded in evidence/environment.json.
Font binaries are not included.

CURRENT COLLECTION

The corrected starting collection contained 61 choices / 53 model files.
Scale Studio, Bloom Gate, Echo Bridge and Bit Keeper brought it to 65 / 57.
Counterturn preserves all 65 entries and adds one, reaching 66 / 58.
Previous models, assets and notices remain in their original packages.
The selected input identities are recorded in evidence/source-identity.json.
